Company Details

Berkley Management Protection

Berkley Management Protection offers a modular suite of management liability products through the GroveSM, their bespoke and easy to use platform tailored towards independent agents. Their Trellis Management Liability PortfolioSM of coverages include directors and officers, employment practices, fiduciary, cyber, crime and miscellaneous professional liability.

Company URL:    https://www.berkleymp.com/

Responsibilities

The Product Manager at Berkley Management Protection will support the development, enhancement, and execution of product strategy across the management liability product suite. This role will focus on product development, coverage innovation, product maintenance, underwriting enablement, and user experience improvements that drive profitable growth and operational excellence.

• Support the development and execution of product and underwriting strategy.
• Assist in the design, development, and implementation of new products, coverage enhancements, and endorsement solutions that address evolving market needs.
• Support product filings and coordinate with legal, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders to facilitate timely implementation of product changes.
• Monitor market trends, emerging risks, competitor activity, and industry developments to identify opportunities for product enhancement and portfolio growth.
• Leverage portfolio performance, production, and market data to support product recommendations, business decisions, and strategic initiatives.
• Develop and maintain underwriting training materials and product documentation to support operational efficiency and consistency.
• Participate in product governance initiatives, including quality assurance reviews, audit standards, underwriting authority enhancements, and operational best practices.
• Partner with underwriting, product management, operations, and technology teams to improve agent portal functionality, workflow efficiency, automation capabilities, and overall user experience.
• Communicate product changes, market insights, and strategic initiatives effectively across the organization.
• Minimum 10% travel required.

Qualifications

Qualifications

• Minimum of 5+ years of Product Management, Product Development, Underwriting, or related insurance experience.
• Demonstrated ability to support the development, enhancement, and management of insurance products and coverage solutions.
• Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate data, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Proven ability to collaborate effectively with underwriting, operations, technology, actuarial, legal, compliance, and distribution partners to deliver an exceptional product experience.
• Valid driver’s license required.

Education Requirement

• Bachelor’s degree in business management/administration, Mathematics, Finance, Risk Management, Actuarial Science or Economics.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees including:
• Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus
• Benefits include: Health, dental, vision, dental, life, disability, wellness, paid time off, 401(k) and profit-sharing plans

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

- Analyze product performance metrics and user data to make informed decisions and drive product improvements.

- Provide and necessary support to end-users, ensuring they are equipped to utilize their CRM effectively.

- Stay updated on industry trends, competitor products, and emerging technologies to inform product development.

- Engage with customers, partners, and stakeholders to gather feedback, understand pain points, and identify opportunities for product improvement.

- Travel approximately 5-10 %

- 5+ years of increasing responsibility for technical direction of a SaaS/PaaS platform , preferably in the CRM or sales automation industry.

- Strong technical background with the ability to understand and communicate complex technical concepts.

- A high technical acumen including the ability to understand and use technologies such as Power Platform, Azure, C#, SQL, Python, Apex, etc.

- Excellent project management and organizational skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make data-driven decisions.

- Ability to thrive and produce results with little or no supervision in a fast-paced environment.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact seamlessly at all levels with both technical and business stakeholders.

- Strong customer service focus and sense of urgency.

- Ability to quickly adapt and learn new technologies and systems.

- Ability to function as a valuable team member inside a virtual collaboration environment.

approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specialized

Company Details

As an elite Excess and Surplus Lines market, Nautilus Insurance Group offers commercial property and casualty insurance solutions to appointed wholesale surplus lines producers countrywide. We have specialized in providing these solutions for more than 35 years.

We have more flexible policy terms and premium rates on a non-admitted basis. Our focus is small to medium Property and Casualty risks on both an admitted and a non-admitted basis.

Our offerings are distributed through partnerships with appointed wholesale surplus lines producers. Our relationships are defined by mutual success, speed to market, customer-centric focus and an expanded appetite.

Coverage placed by Nautilus Insurance Group is provided by Nautilus Insurance Company and Great Divide Insurance Company, both W. R. Berkley Corporation members with A.M. Best (Superior) A+ XV ratings.

Benefit Highlights :
- Paid Parental Leave! At Nautilus, we offer Childbirth Recovery Leave as well as Primary Caregiver Leave, for up to a maximum of 12 weeks of paid leave.
- Nautilus offers Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage options, along with Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) choices
- We help our employees feel secure by providing a 401(k) program, profit sharing, stock purchase plan, life insurance, and travel accident insurance options.
- One of our core values is “Committed to Serve” and these aren’t idle words. We provide every employee one paid day off per year to volunteer at a local charity. That’s serving with a smile!
- We take risk management excellence and your professional growth seriously by offering Tuition Assistance and Industry-Related Education and Exam programs.
- Can you hear us now?  Employees are eligible for special cell phone service discounts with Verizon and AT&T. We’ve got a plum position for you! We participate in the Plum Benefits program offering employees cost-free access to thousands of exclusive travel and entertainment discounts.
- Flexible work arrangements
- On site newly renovated fitness center - free to use for employees.  Yoga and other classes available for a nominal fee.

Responsibilities

Nautilus is  seeking a Director to help shape the direction and performance of our Primary Casualty line of business.  This role will operate with meaningful autonomy while partnering closely with the Vice President, Product Management to execute on both tactical and strategic initiatives. You will collaborate with Product Innovation, Actuarial, Production Underwriting, Digital Solutions, and IT.

This role is be located on a hybrid schedule in our Scottsdale AZ headquarters.

- Leads and develops the Product Development team
- Handle interviewing, hiring, training, performance evaluations, and issue resolution in alignment with company policies and goals.
- Independently research, design, and propose new or enhanced products, underwriting guidelines, policy language, pricing approaches, and market opportunities for the Primary Casualty line.
- Evaluate competitive intelligence and emerging trends to proactively recommend product solutions.
- Drive select product initiatives from concept through implementation, with increasing ownership over time.
- Act as a subject matter expert within the department to identify and provide training opportunities, provide business requirements to IT developers, and possible QA of newly implemented product initiatives or projects.
- Monitor production results, conversion trends, rate adequacy, and profitability
- Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external distribution partners to support product success.
- Use data and insights to recommend adjustments in positioning, pricing, or underwriting strategy.
- Communicate findings and recommendations with an appropriate level of independence and judgment.
- Partner with the Vice President, Product Management to align product roadmap priorities with broader organizational goals.
- Perform additional responsibilities as requested by the Vice President, Product Management.

#LI-Remote

- Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) or equivalent professional experience.
- CPCU, ASLI, AIC or completion of other insurance-related classes is preferred
- 10+ years of experience in Commercial P&C underwriting and/or product management, with a focus on Primary Casualty.
- Excess and surplus lines background beneficial
- Direct supervisory experience preferred.
- Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex data for decision-making.
- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and guide cross‑functional teams.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and grow into expanded responsibilities over time.
